process-group.short: A fixed set of ranks that run collectives together, for example the two ranks of one TP group. vLLM wraps each one in a GroupCoordinator.

rank-layout.short: The order in which vLLM arranges all ranks before it cuts them into groups: ExternalDP × DP × PP × PCP × TP, with TP as the fastest dimension.

group-coordinator.short: vLLM's wrapper for one process group. It holds a gloo CPU group, an NCCL device group, an optional device communicator and an optional shared-memory broadcaster.

device-communicator.short: The platform object that runs the collectives of a group with more than one rank. On CUDA it is CudaCommunicator, which picks pynccl, custom all-reduce, symmetric memory or FlashInfer.

custom-all-reduce.short: vLLM's own all-reduce kernel for small tensors in a TP group, normally on one node. It writes through peer-to-peer GPU memory instead of NCCL.

data-parallel-rank.short: The index of one data parallel replica. In vllm serve each DP rank is one engine core process with its own workers and KV cache.
data-parallel-rank.long: Engine choice per rank at {{cite vllm/v1/engine/core.py:1534-1543}}.

load-balancing-mode.short: How requests reach the DP ranks: internal (the API servers pick an engine), hybrid (per node), or external (one endpoint per rank, an outside router picks).

dp-wave.short: For MoE data parallelism: one period in which all DP engine cores step together. It ends when no rank has unfinished requests; a new request starts the next wave.

fused-moe.short: vLLM's MoE layer. FusedMoEFactory builds a router, a RoutedExperts object with the expert weights, and an MoERunner that runs the layer.

modular-kernel.short: An MoE kernel built from two parts: a prepare/finalize object (quantize and dispatch, then combine) and an experts object (the grouped GEMMs).

all2all-backend.short: The communication method that moves MoE tokens to the ranks of their experts and back. Set with --all2all-backend; the default is allgather_reducescatter.
all2all-backend.long: Choices and default at {{cite vllm/config/parallel.py:45-60}}, {{cite vllm/config/parallel.py:220-234}}.

eplb.short: Expert parallelism load balancer. It counts how many tokens each expert gets and moves or copies busy experts between GPUs every step_interval steps.

dbo.short: Splits a batch into two microbatches that run in two threads, so the MoE dispatch and combine of one overlap with the compute of the other.

kv-producer.short: An instance with kv_role kv_producer: in disaggregated prefill it computes the prompt and keeps the KV blocks until a decode instance has read them.

kv-consumer.short: An instance with kv_role kv_consumer: in disaggregated prefill it loads the prompt's KV blocks from a producer and then decodes.

pd-disaggregation.short: Running prefill and decode of a request on different vLLM instances, with a KV connector that moves the KV cache between them.
